name: AETHERIUS Fundamental Axioms
author: AETHERIUS Research
description: Fundamental laws governing M2M commerce settlement windows

axioms.name: Settlement Window Law
axioms.statement_es: Todo sistema de pago que sirve recursos antes de confirmar settlement crea una ventana de explotación proporcional a la latencia de finalidad y inversamente proporcional al costo de gas.
axioms.statement_en: Any payment system that serves resources before confirming settlement creates an exploitation window proportional to finality latency and inversely proportional to gas cost.
evidence: x402 authorization flow serves before settlement
Gas cost on Base: ~$0.001 per transaction
implications: Providers using optimistic flows MUST implement velocity detection
The window size is determined by L2 finality time, not provider choice
Higher resource value increases exploitation potential

axioms.name: Velocity Exploitation Law
axioms.statement_es: Un agente malicioso maximiza extracción enviando N proofs por segundo, donde N = min(resource_value / gas_cost, detection_threshold).
axioms.statement_en: A malicious agent maximizes extraction by sending N proofs per second, where N = min(resource_value / gas_cost, detection_threshold).
implications: Without velocity detection, attackers can extract unlimited value
The optimal attack rate is determined by the gas/value ratio
Detection systems must operate below the optimal attack rate

axioms.name: Defense Temporal Law
axioms.statement_es: Toda defensa contra explotación de ventana de settlement debe operar en un tiempo menor a la ventana misma, o falla inevitablemente.
axioms.statement_en: Any defense against settlement window exploitation must operate faster than the window itself, or it will inevitably fail.
implications: Asynchronous defense (check after) is insufficient alone
Real-time scoring MUST happen in the request path
The defense must be faster than the attack can repeat
